description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Summon the meeting to fill the vacancy of Vice Chairman of Trincomalee Town and Gravets P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the summoning of a meeting to fill a vacancy for the Vice Chairman position in a local authority (Trincomalee Town & Gravets Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including scheduling a meeting for election purposes, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
